name: CoolDown
description: Use when something kills the mood for the speaking NPC, such as an insult, a threat or bad news. Lowers that NPC's arousal a little.
note: Needs OSL Aroused and Mantella Living World - Arousal. Each use removes 10 arousal (0-100) from the NPC who speaks. Only offered to NPCs close to the player (as the other Arousal actions).
prompt: If something kills the mood for you, such as an insult, a threat or bad news, begin your response with '{key}:'
